global_rules: Prioritize 'Editorial Minimalism': use generous whitespace and let the shoe imagery be the hero.
No generic shadows on product cards. Use flat backgrounds and subtle scale or opacity changes on hover.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
All text content MUST be in Vietnamese.

buttons.primary: bg-[#111111] text-white hover:bg-black/80 rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-colors font-medium text-sm tracking-wide
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E5E5E5] text-[#111111] hover:bg-[#F5F3F0] rounded-none px-8 py-4 transition-colors font-medium text-sm tracking-wide

cards.image: object-cover w-full h-full transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105

shadcn_usage: Sheet: For the shopping cart slide-over.
Dialog: For Product Quick View modal.
Input: Minimalist borders (border-b only or very light border) for search and newsletter.
Select: For product filtering (e.g., Mới nhất, Giá tăng/giảm).
Badge: For 'Mới' or 'Bán chạy' tags on products. Use sharp corners.
Toast (Sonner): Minimalist black toast for 'Đã thêm vào giỏ hàng'.

motion.page_load: Fade in and slight slide up for main elements.
motion.hover: Image scale up (1.05) over 700ms. Button background darken.

images.description: White sneakers with dramatic light and shadows on wooden deck, used for main hero section background or prominent graphic.
Pair of stylish black formal shoes on minimalist background.
Light beige marble/stone surface for testimonial or USP section background.

pages_and_sections.name: Header
pages_and_sections.details: Sticky crystal glass header (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80). Logo 'niceshoe' text in Outfit font. Nav links (Nam, Nữ, Bộ sưu tập). Search icon, Cart icon with badge.

pages_and_sections.name: Hero Section
pages_and_sections.details: Full height or 80vh. Use 'hero' image. Large bold typography: 'Tối giản. Tinh tế. Mỗi bước đi.' CTA button: 'Mua sắm ngay'. Layout should be asymmetrical or text overlay with gradient.

pages_and_sections.name: Category Bento
pages_and_sections.details: 3 blocks: 'Sneakers', 'Giày Công Sở', 'Thời Trang Nữ'. Use product images inside muted background boxes. Overlay text at bottom left.

pages_and_sections.name: Featured Products
pages_and_sections.details: Grid of 4-8 shoes. Show image, name, price. Hovering reveals 'Thêm vào giỏ' and 'Xem nhanh' buttons. Use dummy data for products with provided URLs.

pages_and_sections.name: Why Choose Us (USPs)
pages_and_sections.details: 3 columns. Icons (Truck, ShieldCheck, RefreshCcw). Text: Miễn phí vận chuyển, Bảo hành 1 năm, Đổi trả 30 ngày. Background: subtle texture or off-white.

pages_and_sections.name: Testimonials
pages_and_sections.details: Minimalist text reviews. E.g., 'Thiết kế đẹp, đi rất êm chân.' - Nguyễn Văn A.

pages_and_sections.name: Newsletter & Footer
pages_and_sections.details: Simple input field with 'Đăng ký' button. Footer with links, social icons, and copyright. Dark gray background for footer.

pages_and_sections.name: Shopping Cart (Client-side)
pages_and_sections.details: Shadcn Sheet component. Shows items, quantity controls (+/-), total price, and 'Thanh toán' (placeholder button). Use zustand or Context API for state management.
